scope: Read-only static tooling review of delivery.py, its graph/parser/axiom extractors, existing blind and reused evidence, consumer test, and established verify protocol; no generation, API, CI or main-workspace mutation performed.
verdict: No concrete tooling blocker found in the reviewed version. This passes static implementation review; pending compiler/graph/finalizer/platform outputs must pass the scripted checks before delivery acceptance.

bindings.reuse_guards: Rebind private compiler names by original userName within exact module, check current source SHA256 and exact compiler pretty-printed type against historical rows and passed type/binder audit. All 121 historical helper rows and current source hashes checked during this review.
bindings.fresh_guards: Exactly 23 original blind rows; all original source hashes checked during this review. Current helper parser headers must match raw signatures except one narrowly named, exact-byte letI adaptation. All 23 current compiler names require a fresh passed compiler-type/current-source/binder audit in preflight, including pruned declarations.
bindings.adaptation: Only suppliedPresentationHeight_approx_chosen may insert the exact Model-derived letI : IsCurveField M.K := M.isCurveField in its conclusion. Repair receipt explicitly forbids new hypothesis or public target change. Original blind row and signature retained; current compiler/binder review required. Actual main helper contains exactly this derived-instance form.
bindings.unchanged_target: Platform-before formal statement matches the complete baseline graph node now. The target independent readback is reused; wrapper compiler binding is refreshed.
bindings.coverage: Count 145 and unique compiler-name set enforced. Parser declaration counts and original source names must equal bound rows per each of the 12 helper modules.

pruning.graph: Actual Lean environment traverses both type/value dependencies; theorem proof bodies are read through thmInfo, internal project proof constants are traversed, private source declarations are retained by original names.
pruning.roots: Original exact target plus every compiler-marked instance in all 12 source modules.
pruning.whole_commands: Parser cmdStart/cmdEnd ranges remove complete outer declaration commands; non-overlapping bounds checked; namespace/section/variable contexts retained. No regex proof surgery.
pruning.imports: Inline all helper bodies, strip helper imports, allow only Definitions/Mathlib/Theorems imports, forbid target self-import and Solutions imports; retain existing source notices.
pruning.standalone: The original wrapper declaration is renamed, final solution header comes from exact parser bytes, and direct standalone leaf compilation is a preflight requirement.

target_and_axioms.raw_target_serialization: Generate copies platform formal_statement directly, replaces only the target theorem name, removes only exact suffix := by sorry, and appends := solution. No backslash normalization or manual reconstruction of the property occurs.
target_and_axioms.type_check: AuditSolution Lean.Meta.isDefEq compares current solution type to raw platform original; allowed axioms are only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound.
target_and_axioms.source_module_audit: AuditAllConstants iterates every constant in the 12 helper modules plus wrapper, including compiler-generated declarations, and rejects any other axiom. Preflight requires all graph names covered by output.
target_and_axioms.receipt_checks: Current helper/wrapper leaf+artifact receipts, Checks review, graph/parser, all-constant review, direct solution, original-type/axiom review, production gates, and conditional consumer review must succeed and bind current hashes/arguments/exclusive workspace. Prior eight helper receipts reused only at unchanged source hashes.
target_and_axioms.resource_guard: Present peak RSS measurements must be <=16 GiB; missing measurements are retained as unknown.

publishing.read_only_review: No publish function or imported API helper was executed by reviewer.
publishing.api_boundary: API loader requires ignored untracked credentials, fixed HTTPS API base, no-proxy/no-redirect established opener. It extracts only verify FunctionDef from the old script; old script top-level writes/publishes do not execute.
publishing.uncertain_POST: Before first verify attempt save local verification-requested sentinel. If transport fails without a saved submit response, another publish invocation refuses to repeat POST until explicitly reconciled. With saved submit response, identical request and source hash are required and existing submission is polled.
publishing.receipt_format: Prior accepted verify evidence confirms polling result uses id and POST receipt uses submission_id, so actual-platform-reduction result.get(id) is consistent.
publishing.import_revalidation: Discover full local import closure excluding Mathlib, map every platform theorem module to complete baseline graph, reject self-import/missing module, GET each imported theorem immediately before verify, require name/status Proved/private/exact environment.
publishing.actual_graph_children: After ACCEPTED, fetch complete graph with targeted mathematical drills; require unchanged mathematical theorem-node set and exactly one new ACCEPTED reduction for target. Derive actual children from graph incoming edges, require all Proved and revalidate each child private/exact environment through API. No import-count inference for graph edges.
publishing.frontier: Require root remains Open, paginated frontier complete, and exactly previous 18 IDs minus target yields 17.
publishing.metadata: Paper quotation marked context, formal auxiliary source distinguished from verbatim paper claim, Fermat route retained, source pins recorded, no mathematical parent closure claim.

consumer.review: Conditional example supplies the proved divisor comparison at exact hStrictHeight position and keeps hInput/hCompact/hRegular/hEmbedding/hChoices/hDegree/hCanonical/hHeight/hDifferent/hConductor as hypotheses. Thus it tests actual consumption while leaving other Open obligations explicit.

source_consumer_inventory.requirement: Independent final delivery review must bind final solution hash, mark source ledger checked and actual producer consumers checked. No unsolicited production documentation mutation requested.
